name: Camping zur Mühle
beschreibung: Camping zur Mühle is nestled in a peaceful Tyrolean valley, surrounded by mountainous landscapes and nature. The location is secluded yet offers access to hiking trails and ski resorts. The atmosphere on-site is relaxed and immersed in nature. The facilities include sanitary blocks, electric hookups, and a playground. A small kiosk provides guests with essential groceries. Visitors can enjoy a hassle-free stay with a focus on outdoor activities. The surroundings are perfect year-round for hikers and skiers.
